submit_reasoning: The 130-bar price history shows a mean-reverting series (mean ~99.68, std ~1.20, CV ~1.2%) with a recent uptick to ~102. Seasonality detection found no meaningful periodicity (strength 0.0). Two anomalies were flagged but are consistent with the series' natural volatility. I attempted to incorporate two context events from the article — the May 10 earnings release and the Zacks Hold rating — but both were rejected by the leakage-safe ablation gate, so the forecast falls back to the ETS model on history alone. The selected ETS model projects a gentle upward trajectory from ~101.09 to ~104.29 over 33 steps, consistent with the recent recovery trend visible in the last ~15 bars. Support is degraded (only 130 of 132 required observations), but the forecast is non-abstaining and reasonable given the data.
